run_structsgen: run structsgen.py to generate structs.py from ASSIMP C header files in the include directory
run_Structify: run Structify on a single C header file to extract ctypes Structure class definitions
run_GetType: run GetType to map a C type name like unsigned int to its ctypes equivalent
run_restructure: run restructure on a regex match object to convert a C struct field into a ctypes field tuple
review_structsgen: review structsgen.py to understand how ASSIMP C headers are parsed and converted to Python ctypes
